recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-28433 unless a later work-group decision intentionally changes ActivityDefinition.product[x] target profiles.
issue_request: FHIR-28433 is a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core CDS change request for R5 that asked to add ActivityDefinition.product[x] Reference(Ingredient) so PQ/CMC PlanDefinition batch formulas can identify Ingredient resources used in a drug-product recipe.
initial_application: The Jira comments link PR #1043 and PR #1134. Local history shows 6a288841 first added Ingredient to the ActivityDefinition spreadsheet, 26662ab temporarily reverted the generated StructureDefinition target because R4B tooling did not yet know the Ingredient resource, and 991752b re-added Ingredient to source/activitydefinition/structuredefinition-ActivityDefinition.xml.
additional_context: ActivityDefinition and Ingredient are active in source/fhir.ini. The current ActivityDefinition.product[x] target profile list includes Ingredient alongside Medication, MedicinalProductDefinition, and SubstanceDefinition. FHIR-31529 later requested removal of Ingredient but was retracted/no-change, and the originating Zulip discussion matches the PQ/CMC use case without adding a conflicting requirement.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the current active source already expresses the approved Reference(Ingredient) allowance. Adding duplicate narrative would not change implementer understanding and would add maintenance drift.

related_jiras.note: Companion PQ/CMC PlanDefinition subject change applied through the same PR family; useful background but not needed to decide this ActivityDefinition.product[x] seed.
Later R4B ballot request to remove Ingredient from ActivityDefinition.product[x] was retracted/no-change, supporting retention of the seed change.
Later source commit added MedicinalProductDefinition to the same ActivityDefinition.product[x] target list while preserving Ingredient.
